About

Why we exist

The UnknownNow started with a simple frustration: good neuroscience research rarely reaches the people it's actually about. We built an organization to close that gap.

Our mission

Science communication first, neuroscience as our lens

We are aspiring medical professionals who attempt to understand OUR unknowns in the rapidly growing field of neuroscience. We strive to educate and advocate for the general public on prominent medical issues present in our world today, and to contribute to the advancement of the medical field. We believe credible science shouldn't require a research background to understand, so we translate neuroscience and psychology research into writing that's accurate, specific, and genuinely readable.

We take a foundation-first approach: we'd rather do a small number of things well and honestly than overstate what we've built. If something's still in progress, we say so.

Our story

Why we do this

Through personal challenges with neurological issues, and a lack of resources alongside an unsupportive community, we want to bring change to these challenges. Whether it's through scientific research or community involvement, we aim to find our unknowns.
